1.overview: Ryōta Sakamoto is ranked #10 worldwide in Btooom!, an online game where players kill each other with bombs. After a game one day, he mysteriously awakes in a real life version of the game.
1.summary:
Ryota Sakamoto one of Japans top BTOOOM! players wakes up to find it is no longer 
a game.
Source: crunchyroll

2.overview: A typical high school girl, betrayed by her neighbors, a forced player in the game of Btooom!, betrayed by the group she teamed up with. All men are scum.
2.summary:
